description: Routing fixture for error-handling-review. Positive cases keep error-handling / silent-failure / fallback intents with this skill; negative controls keep general diff review with local-review, security scanning with secure-code, and completion-proof with verify-before-complete.

cases.prompt: Review the error handling in this change — I want to find any swallowed errors, empty catch blocks, or places we log and continue instead of surfacing the failure.
Audit the fallback behavior in this API client — check the catch blocks and any default-on-failure values that might be hiding the real error from the user.
Give this diff a general code review covering correctness, performance, and maintainability.
Run a semgrep SAST scan on this codebase and check for injection and credential-exposure vulnerabilities.
